name: agent-plugins
description: Anton Dziatkovskii's agent plugins in one catalog: quality gates, second opinions, agent control scorecard, rules as files, session retro, compact block, note recall and a turn ledger.

plugins.name: break-it-first
plugins.description: Post-build quality gate skill: after an agent builds something executable, it runs it live, breaks it on purpose, checks visibility, asks rival models to attack it and gives a verdict with evidence before saying done. Instructions only.

plugins.name: secondop-panel
plugins.description: Second opinion from a panel of reviewer models from different labs, run with uvx secondop-panel==1.0.1. Quorum is counted by model family; exit 3 means no independent second opinion. Instructions only: the plugin ships no code, you supply panel.json and your own API keys or CLI logins.

plugins.name: agent-leash
plugins.description: Score an AI agent setup with the LEASH-8 worksheet: 24 statements across 8 control domains, a band, and the three cheapest missing controls. Instructions only: runs no code and changes nothing.

plugins.name: rules-as-files
plugins.description: Keep rules for you, your team and your AI agents as one markdown file per rule, with a short index line in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. Covers rule intake, precedence, a declined-decisions journal and objection lists. Instructions only.

plugins.name: claw-retro
plugins.description: End-of-session retrospective skill for Claude Code. Inventories what a session actually built, classifies each artifact keep/one-off/promote, routes durable rules to one home with a door audit, archives a retro note and prints a ready /compact paste-block. Instructions only.

plugins.name: compact-canon
plugins.description: Prints a filled 7-header block to paste after /compact in Claude Code, so the summary keeps decisions, their reasons, exact paths and values. Instructions only: this plugin runs nothing and cannot run /compact for you.

plugins.name: sqlite-graph-memory
plugins.description: Recall workflow for linked markdown notes using a separately configured sqlite-graph-memory MCP server. Instructions only: this plugin does not install or start a server. Requires an existing memory_recall tool and a previously built index.

plugins.name: charm-os
plugins.description: TurnState Stop hook that writes each turn (your prompt, a clipped reply summary, files, tools, shell commands) into a local SQLite database, plus two skills: rdr (recall, research prompt, decision memo) and agent-trace-eval (score multi-agent JSONL traces against safety invariants). Requires python3. Nothing is sent over the network.
